name: B10-0361/2026 (Renew) – The threat of war crimes, the escalating violations of international humanitarian law and the human rights situation in El-Obeid, Sudan
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the threat of war crimes, the escalating violations of international humanitarian law and the human rights situation in El-Obeid, Sudan
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for an immediate halt to the Rapid Support Forces offensive on El-Obeid in Sudan, where 500,000 civilians are at risk. It condemns attacks on civilians, hospitals and aid workers, and asks all sides to stop acts that may amount to war crimes. It wants safe aid access, investigations into abuses, more EU humanitarian money, and sanctions on commanders and backers of the Rapid Support Forces. This is a statement of the Parliament's position, not a change in law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet in law; the Parliament demands a halt to the El-Obeid offensive and sanctions on Rapid Support Forces backers.
- **Who it affects:** Civilians in El-Obeid and North Kordofan, aid workers, and commanders and financiers named.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to the EU Council, Commission, African Union, UN and others; the Council decides on sanctions.
